summary: Paper-fidelity config run (32 envs, 500k buffer, seed 42) on the post-TF32/mask code. test/grasp has oscillated between 0.0 and 0.094 for 117k episodes with zero upward trend — far past the paper's 20-50k ON_TRACK window for grasp>=0.9 and past the 50k re-check deadline set by the previous check (run 6418601d). Meanwhile throughput is excellent (~18k ep/hr, confirming the perf changes), but the policy is not learning. Cross-run archaeology: the same config+seed pair that succeeded on the 07-17 image (832c0e2: grasp 0.9 by ep 5003, 128-env config) is stuck on the current image (a9402350: <=0.16 at 21k), and a 07-20 stale-image run (7654c46a, pre-TF32 code) already looked slow (0.016 at 3k vs 832c0e2's 0.266). The instrumentation commit 4f33ebe was diff-reviewed and is semantically inert; the vectorized pad mask is proven bit-identical (PoC assert); empty_cache removal is numerically inert. Prime remaining suspect is TF32, with a secondary possibility that the regression predates it (unknown drift between the 07-17 and 07-20 Docker images).

findings.description: grasp never crossed 0.5 (max 0.094) through 117k episodes; paper ON_TRACK window for >=0.9 is 20-50k. All grow_* at 0.0 (EXPECTED at this stage only if grasp were on track; here they are downstream casualties).
findings.recommendation: Stop the run — it is not converging and each additional hour spends GPU time on a non-learning policy.

findings.description: Suspected code/build regression between the 07-17 Docker image (healthy: 832c0e2 crossed 0.5 at ep 4014) and current builds (a9402350, same 128-env config and seed 0, stuck <=0.16 at 21k; this run stuck <=0.094 at 117k). Candidate causes, in order: (1) TF32 enabled in commit 0caf5f2 — the only numerically-active change in that commit (mask change is bit-identical by PoC assert, empty_cache is inert); (2) unknown drift baked into the 07-20 image before TF32 existed — supported weakly by 7654c46a (old code, grasp 0.016 at 3k where healthy runs were 0.27-0.95); commit 4f33ebe itself was diff-reviewed clean.
findings.recommendation: Discriminating experiment (~45 min): relaunch the 128-env config, seed 0, with TF32 forced off via NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE=0 in docker-compose environment (no code change needed — this env var overrides torch.backends allow_tf32). Healthy behavior = grasp >0.5 by ~4-5k episodes. If still stuck, rebuild from commit 7001485 (pre-instrumentation) and repeat to isolate image drift.

findings.description: Estimated LP is near zero everywhere (lp_grasp 0.007) — correct behavior given the policy genuinely has no learning progress; sibling run 6418601d showed sr_impossibles converging cleanly to ~0.002 (better than the healthy-policy 832c0e2 run, which had it stuck at 0.27). SR head is not the problem.

No NaNs (6717 points). Entropy rose 0.06->1.54 then drifted down to ~0.68 plateau; alpha decayed to 0.0015 with grasp unsolved. The healthy run's alpha also decayed to ~0 while learning, so alpha collapse alone is not discriminating — but a near-zero entropy bonus on top of a non-learning policy removes the escape hatch.
findings.recommendation: Resolves itself if the regression root cause is fixed; not worth tuning alpha independently until then.

findings.description: Throughput on the paper config with the new code is ~18k ep/hr (117k eps in ~6.5h) — the perf changes work as measured. goals_distribution puts 80% of goals on impossibles; identical in the healthy runs, so not the regression cause.

comparison: Hardens the INVESTIGATE from run 6418601d (same failure pattern at 24k, re-check deadline 50k) into a confirmed learning failure at 117k. Unlike 832c0e2, the SR head now converges on impossibles — the regression is specific to the actor/critic path.
paper_vs_run: Far below paper on the policy axis: grasp unsolved at 117k vs paper's 20-50k window; all grow_* at zero. SR-head competence estimation is on or above paper trajectory. Root cause suspected in the training stack (TF32 or image drift), not in the MAGELLAN sampler.
